description: Lists the projects this connection can act on, with each one's projectId, name, plan, and verified sending domains. An OAuth connection reaches every project the signed-in user is an owner, admin, or editor of; a project API key reaches only its own. When there is more than one, pass the right projectId as `project_id` on every other tool call — a call without it fails rather than guessing.
name: volanea_list_projects

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

projects.description: Each with projectId, name, plan, and verifiedDomains (domain names).

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
